note: T-214 validation: every measure where the measurer and T-204's hand trace of the same T-202 render differ by more than the T-204 tolerance, with the reason. test_measurer.py fails on any disagreement not listed here. Categories: H = hand crown/chin estimate (agrees once the hand crown and chin are used); TRACE = hand trace differs from the render (checked on the pixels); SHADE = Cycles shading moves an edge the masks cannot see (the eye-opening lid shadow is now calibrated, views.json lid_shadow_h); RIM = hand stopped at the glasses rim; HIDDEN = feature hidden under hair or lens, hand estimate (E). START = contour start row: T-204 only says 'from above iris level'; the measurer starts between the opening top and the iris centre, not above the ear tops, and F is the widest span below that. PREC = the tolerance is below one 400-grid trace unit on this feature.

auburn.three_quarter/chin_width: HIDDEN: the near cheek and jaw are crossed by a long lock (T-204 note); hand contour E converges inside the skin edge.
